description: A shell script for testing Git's untracked cache functionality, including setup, status checks, cache dumping, and various scenarios involving file modifications, sparse checkouts, and worktrees.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Synchronizes directory mtimes by finding directories and listing their details.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Pauses execution for 1 second to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: status_is_clean
methods.description: Checks if the git status is clean and the status file is empty.

methods.name: iuc
methods.description: Runs git commands with untracked cache disabled and manages temporary index files.

methods.name: get_relevant_traces
methods.description: Extracts relevant performance trace data from Git trace output.
